title: Detect unmapped and inconsistent product coverage
goal: Compare active registries, canonical owned entities, source Requirement identities and observed references to produce a deterministic, source-backed coverage-gap report.
required_checks: canonical capability absent from active register
canonical screen absent from active register
source Requirement never referenced by active corpus
permission reference absent from permission register
open-decision reference absent from active open-decision register
definition_of_done: gap categories are explicit and independently countable
every reported reference gap includes at least one source path
known active sets are reconciled against owned entities
current corpus gap report is generated in CI
tests cover missing owner, unregistered owner, unreferenced active id and unregistered reference
report generation does not mutate Product Spec
